The search turned up several relevant GitHub threads, mostly in facebook/react and in projects that use React 19 through frameworks.

- **Extension-injected attributes and scripts:** Issue #25924 (opened Dec 2022, React 18.2.0) reports that a React DevTools extension injected a script tag after `<body>`, which triggered hydration errors. The reporter asked whether the extension should add `suppressHydrationWarning` to it. Issue #24430 (React 18) describes a similar case where a plugin's script tag at the top of the page caused a mismatch. The reporter asked whether React could handle this case in its matching logic.
- **React 19 behavior:** Video Speed Controller's issue #1255 cites the React team's position from the React 19 release post. Per that thread, React 19 skips unexpected tags in `<head>` and `<body>`, and leaves stylesheets inserted by extensions in place if it re-renders the document. Extensions that change other elements can still cause mismatches.
- **Attribute mismatches in Next.js 15 with React 19:** Next.js discussion #72035 traces a hydration error to the `cz-shortcut-listen` attribute added by the ColorZilla extension. One commenter shared a workaround that removes the attribute before hydration and uses a MutationObserver to stop it from returning.
- **Recent reports:** Issue #35210 (React 19.2.0, opened Nov 2025) describes random hydration failures during navigation with Mantine components. The thread includes the standard extension explanation, but the reporter's extension was not identified. Sentry issue #15886 covers ignoring React error 418 in React 19 projects, and it notes that the extension cause is also listed in the official message.
- **Fixes in other repos:** A fix in suv27/Layer7-Siege (PR #26, Sep 2026) adds `suppressHydrationWarning` only to the root body element to handle attributes from browser extensions. An open issue in himan243/LeetTrack (Sep 2026) reports the same problem with CrossPilot and ColorZilla.

I did not search for a React-team resolution that closes these reports, so I can't confirm whether facebook/react has a fix for extension-caused mismatches. Most of the facebook/react threads above are older or describe React 18, so check the current state of each issue before relying on it.

content.text:
Yes, there are several. I found no single canonical issue that is specific to React 19.

**In facebook/react**
- [#25924](https://github.com/facebook/react/issues/25924): "Scripts injected by browser extensions (e.g. React dev tools) may cause hydration errors." This is the closest match, but it was filed in Dec 2022 against React 18.2.
- [#24430](https://github.com/facebook/react/issues/24430): a plugin that generates a script tag at the top of the page causes a hydration mismatch. It is also a React 18 report.
- [#35210](https://github.com/facebook/react/issues/35210): attribute mismatches on React 19.2.0 (Nov 2025), reported with Mantine components. The thread gives the usual extension explanation, but the reporter's extension wasn't identified.

**React 19 with frameworks and tools**
- [Next.js discussion #72035](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/discussions/72035): a Next.js 15 + React 19 hydration error caused by the `cz-shortcut-listen` attribute that the ColorZilla extension adds. One commenter shared a workaround that removes the attribute before hydration and uses a MutationObserver to stop it from returning.
- [Sentry issue #15886](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/issues/15886): ignoring the React 19 hydration error (418), which the official error message lists as possibly extension-related.
- [Video Speed Controller issue #1255](https://github.com/igrigorik/videospeed/issues/1255): cites the React 19 release post. According to that thread, React 19 skips unexpected tags in `<head>` and `<body>`. Extensions that modify other elements can still cause mismatches.

I didn't check whether any of these have been closed or resolved, so look at each one's current status.

The usual workaround is `suppressHydrationWarning` on the root `<html>` or `<body>` element.

- https://github.com/igrigorik/videospeed/issues/1255
